atDirectives.name: @theme
atDirectives.description: Use the `@theme` directive to define your project's custom design tokens, like fonts, colors, and breakpoints.

atDirectives.name: @source
atDirectives.description: Use the `@source` directive to explicitly specify source files that aren't picked up by Tailwind's automatic content detection.

atDirectives.name: @apply
atDirectives.description: Use the `@apply` directive to inline any existing utility classes into your own custom CSS. This is useful when you find a common utility pattern in your HTML that you'd like to extract to a new component.

atDirectives.name: @utility
atDirectives.description: Use the `@utility` directive to define custom utility classes.

atDirectives.name: @variant
atDirectives.description: Use the `@variant` directive to define custom variants.

atDirectives.name: @plugin
atDirectives.description: Use the `@plugin` directive to register plugins.

atDirectives.name: @reference
atDirectives.description: Use the `@reference` directive to import theme variables from other CSS files.

atDirectives.name: @custom-variant
atDirectives.description: Use the `@custom-variant` directive to define custom variants with specific selectors.
